newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL finds more oil in Hungarian field.
newsitem.headline: MOL finds more oil in Hungarian field.

text.p: Hungarian oil and gas company Magyar Olaj- es Gazipari Rt (MOL) announced on Monday it had discovered oil reserves in Savoly-South, an area in production since 1980.
"The size of the reserves may be significantly higher than the previously expected 2.5 million barrels," MOL said in a press release.

It also said that the reserves will be quantified more exactly later this year. The density of the crude oil is 27.4 degrees API and the gas in the crude oil is high calorific value gas, the statement added.
However, MOL also said it did not foresee further large finds in Hungary.
"We do not expect significant new domestic findings because Hungary is a mature area".
